title: Reader first: one reading column; the page tree in a drawer on every viewport; a sticky docs bar with Contents, breadcrumb and a persistent search field; the table of contents as a sticky strip under the title
axis: what is dominant: the page being read, not the tree around it
worse_at: Browsing: the page tree is never beside the page, so finding a section's sibling pages costs a click on every viewport; about half of 1440 is empty margin; the 'sidebar entry highlighted' of J3.3 and J1.5 exists only inside the open drawer, and the breadcrumb carries 'where am I'; long pages push the heading strip into a 'more' overflow.
